name: Maria — metastatic breast cancer, San Diego
description: Intake pins down receptor status, then finds qualifying trials plus near-misses with concrete paths (washout windows, a missing test, cohort fit).
firstMessage: I'm looking for trials for my mom Maria. She's 54, lives in San Diego, and has metastatic breast cancer. She's already been treated with trastuzumab and paclitaxel.
answers: Her cancer is HER2-positive. The last biopsy also showed ER-positive and PR-negative.
She finished her last paclitaxel infusion about two weeks ago and is still on trastuzumab. Her last scan showed no brain metastases.
She had an echocardiogram about a month ago and it was normal — ejection fraction around 60%. Her overall condition is good, she's up and about most of the day.
She hasn't had any genomic or biomarker testing beyond the receptor status — no PIK3CA or PD-L1 testing that we know of.
She can travel anywhere in Southern California for visits. No other major health problems besides controlled high blood pressure.
No, she hasn't received any other HER2-targeted drugs — just the trastuzumab with paclitaxel as her first treatment.
